guide.title: Practice hand
guide.intro: You play with Iara against Zap and Bento. Every step is explained. Nothing from this hand leaves your device.
guide.deal: Three cards each. The card turned up on the deck is the vira: {vira}.
guide.manilha: The next rank after the vira becomes the manilha: {rankpl}. A manilha beats every other card.
guide.youHave: You hold a manilha: {card}. Keep it for when you need it.
guide.signal: Iara sent a signal only you can see: no manilha and no three. Signals can be lies.
guide.firstTurn: You lead the round. The strongest card takes it. Try {card}, your highest card besides the manilha.
guide.secondTurn: Your team already has a round. Try {card}, your weakest card, and keep the strongest.
guide.roundWin: {winner} took the round: {card} is the strongest card on the table.
guide.roundManilha: {winner} took the round with a manilha.
guide.roundTie: A tie. Outside the manilhas the suit does not count.
guide.truco: Zap called truco to raise the hand. You can also answer by calling six.
guide.raise: Zap called {call}. The answer is on the panel.
guide.lastTurn: Time for the manilha: {card} beats any plain card.
guide.handWon: Your team took the hand and {points} points. The game goes to 12.
guide.handLost: They took the hand and {points} points. The game goes to 12.
guide.handTie: Nobody took the hand, so nobody scores. The game goes to 12.
guide.outro.title: Now a real match.
guide.outro.text: Start against Otávio, the most cautious one. The rules are on the R key and in the menu.
